name: Krzysztof Nowak
description: Krzysztof Nowak is a Polish illustrator and graphic designer known for his bold, retro-inspired compositions and anarchic humor. Based in Ruda Śląska, Poland, Nowak has built a distinctive visual style that blends dynamic layouts with surreal, often satirical imagery. He is the founder of the creative label MSZZ™ and is represented by Good Illustration Agency. His client list includes major names such as The New York Times, The Economist, McDonald’s, Bloomberg Businessweek, and Jägermeister. Nowak’s work often features vibrant colors, layered textures, and a playful yet critical take on contemporary culture. He is active on platforms like Behance and ArtStation, where he showcases editorial illustrations, branding projects, and experimental visuals.
